purpose: Define feasibility and measurement readiness before any learner-outcome claim.

prohibited: learner efficacy, retention, transfer, or population-level impact
causal claims about the curriculum or adaptive recommendations
security or privacy assurance beyond the observed pilot controls

participants.identifier: Random study identifier generated before export; never an email or account name.

primary.estimand: proportion of consented participants with complete, linkable event records
primary.measure: record completeness by required event field and participant
primary.feasibilityBoundary: A complete record supports a future study; it does not show that learning occurred.

secondary.measure: consented participants divided by eligible invitees
secondary.interpretationBoundary: Descriptive feasibility only; no generalization beyond the recruited sample.

secondary.measure: attempt count, completion status, and missingness by skill
secondary.interpretationBoundary: Do not interpret as item validity, mastery, efficacy, or transfer.

privacy.consent: Collect explicit consent before any export; record version and timestamp.
privacy.retention: Delete raw event exports after the preregistered retention window; retain only approved aggregates.
privacy.access: Restrict raw exports to the named analysis team; log access and prohibit ad hoc learner lookup.
privacy.minimization: Export only fields needed for the preregistered feasibility and missingness analyses.

missingData.classification: Classify structural, intermittent, withdrawal-related, and unknown missingness before analysis.
missingData.primaryAnalysis: Report denominators and observed missingness; do not silently impute completion or quiz outcomes.
missingData.sensitivityAnalysis: Repeat descriptive summaries under documented best-case and worst-case bounds; label them as sensitivity bounds.

analysis.unitOfAnalysis: participant for feasibility and event for completeness diagnostics
analysis.preregistration: Record outcomes, exclusions, windows, and stopping rules before inspecting learner outcomes.
analysis.stoppingRule: Stop collection if consent, privacy, export integrity, or adverse-event review fails.
analysis.notebookContract: A versioned notebook must load only the declared schema, emit deterministic tables, and write a run manifest with code and input hashes.

export.sourceBoundary: SkillTree remains the system of record for progress and quiz state; this contract describes a read-only analysis export.
